message.content:
Below is a concise, province‑by‑province snapshot of the **long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a holiday that falls on a weekday (or is observed on a weekday) and therefore gives you at least three consecutive days off (Friday‑Sunday or Thursday‑Sunday).

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Province(s) / Territory(ies) Affected | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---------|-------------|----------------------------------------|-------------------|-------|
| **Family Day** | Feb 20 (Mon) | Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario (except Toronto) | Feb 17–20 (Fri–Mon) | Creates a 4‑day break (including the weekend). |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Fri) | All provinces & territories | Apr 7–9 (Fri–Sun) | Standard 3‑day break. |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Mon) | All provinces & territories | May 19–22 (Fri–Mon) | 4‑day break. |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Mon) | All provinces & territories | Sep 1–4 (Fri–Mon) | 4‑day break. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Mon) | All provinces & territories | Oct 6–9 (Fri–Mon) | 4‑day break. |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 (Thu) | All provinces & territories | Nov 11–13 (Thu–Sun) | 3‑day break. |
| **Christmas** | Dec 25 (Mon) | All provinces & territories | Dec 22–25 (Fri–Mon) | 4‑day break. |
| **Boxing Day** | Dec 26 (Tue) | All provinces & territories | Dec 22–26 (Fri–Tue) | 5‑day break (includes the weekend). |

### Quick Summary

| Month | Long‑Weekend Holiday(s) | Typical Break Length |
|-------|--------------------------|----------------------|
| February | Family Day | 4 days (Fri–Mon) |
| April | Good Friday | 3 days (Fri–Sun) |
| May | Victoria Day | 4 days (Fri–Mon) |
| September | Labour Day | 4 days (Fri–Mon) |
| October | Thanksgiving | 4 days (Fri–Mon) |
| November | Remembrance Day | 3 days (Thu–Sun) |
| December | Christmas + Boxing Day | 5 days (Fri–Tue) |

> **Tip for App Integration** – If you want to flag *all* long weekends regardless of province, simply use the “All provinces & territories” row. If you need province‑specific data, filter by the “Province(s) / Territory(ies) Affected” column.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like additional details (e.g., observed dates for holidays that fell on weekends, or province‑specific holidays such as St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario).
